defaultPlaceholderHint.description: Hint used by rules that do not set their own placeholderHint. Each match is replaced by <HINT:HASH>.

rules.description: Map of rule name to rule. The key is the name used in logs. Rules whose key collides with one from the other config file are taken from the working-directory config.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source, or an exact string when literal is true.

flags.description: Regular expression flags. The global flag (g) is always added.

literal.description: Treat pattern as a literal string instead of a regular expression.

placeholderHint.description: Overrides defaultPlaceholderHint for this rule. Must not contain <, > or :.
